Class Audio

java.lang.Object
com.vaadin.flow.component.Component
com.vaadin.flow.component.HtmlComponent
com.vaadin.flow.component.HtmlContainer
org.dellroad.stuff.vaadin24.audio.Audio
All Implemented Interfaces:
AttachNotifier, DetachNotifier, HasComponents, HasComponentsOfType<Component>, HasElement, HasEnabled, HasSize, HasStyle, HasText, Serializable
@Tag("audio") public class Audio extends HtmlContainer
Represents an HTML &lt;audio&gt; tag.

By default this class enables display of the audio controls.
